advisory_en: RAM NAGAR: flood probability 78% — risk level HIGH. Flagged at this risk level since 05:30 IST. Highest probability so far at 09:30 IST. About 83,657 residents are in the exposed area, with 3 hospital(s), 2 school(s) and 51.9 km of road. Main drivers: near an underpass, rainfall today, dense built-up. 1 pump(s) are mapped in this ward.

actions: Deploy the 1 mapped pump(s) to the lowest points of RAM NAGAR
Confirm access routes to 3 hospital(s) remain passable
